pedagogical_review.notes: Pedagogical review confirmed progression from terminology disambiguation and balances through interfaces, modes, lifecycle obligations, adversarial cases, and operational validation. Ten substantive examples and five complete answers require classification, calculation, comparison, diagnosis, and design rather than recall alone.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
